routes.auth.ts: Google OAuth, JWT login/register/logout, password reset
routes.search.ts: Song/artist/album search, suggestions, stream proxy, autoplay
routes.playlist.ts: CRUD for user playlists, song add/remove/reorder
routes.user.ts: User preferences, history, liked songs, stats
routes.ai.ts: AI playlist build (Groq LLaMA), mood generation, SSE streaming
routes.recommendations.ts: Home recs, next-song recs, feed pagination
routes.feedback.ts: User feedback submission and admin management

services.youtubeMusicService.ts: YT Music via youtubei.js — search, stream proxy, normalization
services.searchEnhancer.ts: Intent parsing, query expansion, scoring, L1 cache
services.groq.ts: Groq LLaMA API wrapper with key rotation
services.redis.ts: Upstash Redis REST API with in-memory fallback

models.User.ts: User schema (Google OAuth, preferences, liked songs)

middleware.softAuth.ts: Optional JWT — attaches userId if present
middleware.rateLimiter.ts: Sliding window rate limiter (Redis or in-memory)

socket.roomHandlers.ts: SoulLink room events (join, leave, sync, chat)

api.backend.ts: Axios client for all backend routes (615 lines)
api.jiosaavn.ts: JioSaavn API wrapper (search, songs, albums, artists)

external_dependencies.youtubei.js: YouTube Music internal API (search, stream, artist, album)
external_dependencies.Groq LLaMA 3.3: AI playlist generation via API keys
external_dependencies.Upstash Redis: REST-based Redis for caching and rate limiting
external_dependencies.MongoDB Atlas: Primary database for users, playlists, history
external_dependencies.JioSaavn API (legacy): Referenced in env vars but search.ts no longer uses it directly — all routing goes through youtubei.js

websocket_events.join-room: Guest joins a room by code
